heading: Purpose & Scope
content: Defines the steps for deploying and handing over software releases to customers.

heading: Roles & Responsibilities
content: Software Support Engineer executes the deployment, runs the pre-deployment checklist, and performs the client handover. Team Leader/Tech Lead reviews and signs off on the deployment before it proceeds to production.

heading: Pre-Deployment Checklist
content: [MANDATORY] Software Support Engineer must confirm: passing test suite, updated release notes, rollback plan documented, and customer notified at least 24 hours in advance.

heading: Deployment Approval Gate
content: [MANDATORY] No production deployment may proceed without a Team Leader sign-off recorded in the deployment log. Deployments without recorded sign-off are treated as policy violations under Workplace Conduct Policy (DOC-04 Section 6).

heading: Rollback Procedure
content: If critical issues are detected within 2 hours of deployment, Software Support Engineer must execute the documented rollback plan and notify the Team Leader immediately.

heading: Client Handover Steps
content: Software Support Engineer confirms functionality with the customer and closes the deployment ticket. Any customer-reported issue post-deployment is routed through the Customer Escalation Process (DOC-07 Section 4).

heading: Optional Tooling Recommendation
content: [OPTIONAL] Teams are encouraged, but not required, to adopt automated deployment pipelines for repetitive release types.

heading: Cross-References
content: Post-deployment issue escalation: DOC-07 Section 4. Sign-off violation handling: DOC-04 Section 6.
